A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Show-o. All 27 pages of v5 and 25 pages of v7, including figures, tables, equations and appendices, support reliable comparison. Substantial relocation of content can be matched across versions.

before.justification: v5 reports original multimodal understanding and image-generation evaluations, ablations, and qualitative generation results in Tables 1–5 and Figures 7–12.

after.justification: v7 retains original benchmark results and ablations and additionally reports video understanding, video generation and mask-free editing demonstrations.

M1.justification: The backbone, QK-Norm, omni-attention, NTP/MTP objectives and training pipeline remain. v7 adds localized adaptations: inflating MAGVIT-v2 for temporally compressed video tokens (Section 4.5) and iterative random masking for editing without predefined masks (Appendix J).

E1.justification: Beyond v5's image tasks and GenHowTo keyframe-caption generation, v7 demonstrates temporally compressed video understanding and generation, plus mask-free object and style editing (Section 4.5, Appendices H and J). These substantially expand the tested task requirements. Existing image benchmarks remain.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds VILA-U and Emu3; Table 3 adds Emu3 and Transfusion. SEED-X disappears from the qualitative VQA comparison, and v5's qualitative generation comparison against SDXL, LlamaGen, LWM and SEED-X is removed. All original quantitative comparator rows remain.

E3.justification: The added video experiments specify 17-frame, 256×256 inputs at 8 FPS, compressed into 5×16×16 tokens; Figure 8 displays six sampled frames. Existing image benchmark metrics, splits, resolution settings and reported training budgets remain unchanged. The video setup is an added protocol.

E4.justification: The dataset/resolution, encoder, representation, pretraining, sampling-step and guidance analyses remain, as do the failure cases. Qualitative captioning and prompt-alignment comparisons are trimmed, while Appendix J adds cases examining mask-free local modifications and global style changes.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Added results retain point-estimate and qualitative reporting.

E6.justification: The qualitative evidence changes substantially through added video and mask-free editing outcomes, removed comparison grids, and revised VQA and inpainting outputs. Table 3 newly reports Show-o‡ at 0.69 overall alongside unchanged Show-o at 0.68, and new comparator scores are added. Existing numerical result rows remain unchanged. The stated LDM margin changes from 0.31 to 0.24, contradicting the retained scores of 0.68 and 0.37.

T1.justification: v5 Section 3 and Appendix A.1 reappear in v7 Appendices A–B with unchanged diffusion definitions, transition matrices, ELBO reasoning and lower-bound proof. The objective and sampling equations are also retained; renumbering and relocation introduce no mathematical change.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusion preserve the central unification and performance claims. The introduction and contribution list explicitly add video understanding and video generation, extending v5's emphasis on mixed-modality keyframes and prospective long-form video generation.

C2.justification: v7 removes qualitative superiority arguments involving SEED-X and other generation baselines, and describes performance against SD3 as comparable rather than better. The FID distribution-mismatch caveat, pretraining interpretations and explanations of text-recognition, counting and generation failures remain.

D1.justification: Appendix G supplies full prompts for retained generated images, and Section 4.5 documents video encoding dimensions and frame rate. Appendices E–F revise fine-tuning provenance from the named public sources in v5's setup to about 1M internal pairs, already mentioned for v5's scaled model. Hardware, optimizer settings and code/model release information remain.

R1.justification: v7 adds Unified-IO 2, VILA-U, Emu3 and Transfusion references, while removing JourneyDB, Radford's 2018 work, Murphy's textbook and Gu's 2024 tokenizer reference. Related-work descriptions are shortened, but the central positioning against separate expert models and fully autoregressive unified models remains.

P1.justification: The document is substantially reorganized: preliminaries, training pipeline, inference, dataset details, implementation information, most ablations and failure cases move into dedicated appendices. Related work and experimental prose are condensed, and nested experimental subsections become shorter inline discussions.

P2.justification: v7 reduces the VQA display, removes the comparative portion of v5 Figure 8, and combines selected inpainting and keyframe examples with new video panels in Figure 8. It adds video and mask-free editing figures, relocates several existing displays, and removes the image-token-count column from Table 4.

improvement.justification: Newer unified-model comparisons, generation results for Show-o‡, demonstrated video/editing extensions and disclosed image prompts modestly strengthen the paper while preserving its proofs and ablations. The gains are limited by sparse video training details and qualitative-only video evaluation. Removing qualitative baseline comparisons and introducing the incorrect 0.24 GenEval margin are countervailing weaknesses.
